details.description:
Lightweight Hydration for Everyday Skin
When your skin needs moisture but heavy body lotions feel uncomfortable, Vaseline® Light Hydrate 48hr Serum-in-Lotion offers a lighter way to care for it. This fast-absorbing body moisturiser combines a serum-in-lotion texture with more than 90% water content for comfortable daily hydration. It spreads easily and leaves skin feeling smooth, silky and non-sticky rather than greasy or weighed down.
The formula helps attract moisture, support moisture retention and condition the skin. It is suitable for everyday application across the body, including the arms, legs, hands, feet, elbows and knees.
How the Formula Works
Vaseline Light Hydrate 48hr Serum-in-Lotion uses a blend of humectants and lightweight skin-conditioning ingredients. Humectants draw water towards the skin, while the lotion’s conditioning system helps create a smooth after-feel and supports moisture retention.
Its lightweight silicone emollient system improves spreadability and helps the lotion absorb quickly. Combined with the formula’s high water content and absence of heavy waxes and oils, this creates the super-light sensory profile that makes the lotion comfortable in warm or humid weather.
Key Ingredients
Sodium Hyaluronate: Also described as Hyaluron, this water-binding ingredient attracts and retains moisture at the skin’s surface. It helps skin feel hydrated, smoother and more comfortably plumped.
Glycerin: This well-known humectant draws moisture to the skin and helps maintain hydration. It works with Hyaluron to support softer, smoother-feeling skin during daily use.
Niacinamide 1%: This skin-conditioning form of Vitamin B3 supports a brighter, more even-looking appearance with regular use. It also contributes to the formula’s everyday skincare benefits.
Lightweight Silicone Emollient System: This system supports quick absorption, easy spreading and a silky after-feel without the heaviness associated with richer creams.
What It Helps Do
Vaseline Light Hydrate helps moisturise skin while supporting a softer and smoother texture. Its serum-in-lotion format delivers hydration in a light layer that absorbs without leaving a sticky finish. The formula is designed to help reduce the uncomfortable feeling associated with dry or dehydrated skin while keeping daily body care easy.
Niacinamide supports a brighter and more even-looking appearance over time. Hyaluron and glycerin help attract and retain moisture, while the lightweight conditioning system gives the skin a smooth finish after application.
Who It Is For
Vaseline Light Hydrate 48hr Serum-in-Lotion is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types. Its lightweight texture is particularly useful for people who want daily hydration without a heavy or greasy feel, including those with normal, dry, combination or mildly oily skin.
It is also suited to warm climates, humid weather, air-conditioned environments and routines where quick absorption matters. Apply more product to areas that tend to feel especially dry, such as elbows, knees, hands and feet.
Gentle Everyday Care
The formulation is alcohol-free and contains more than 90% water, helping create a light and comfortable sensory profile. Vaseline® Light Hydrate is suitable for regular, long-term body care and can be used in the morning, evening or whenever skin feels dry.
For the best moisture-retention routine, apply the lotion after bathing or showering, when clean skin is ready for moisturisation. Massage it evenly until fully absorbed.
Tested Hydration Support
Vaseline Light Hydrate is dermatologically tested for skin suitability. Clinical testing assessed hydration with a Corneometer and water loss with a Tewameter. The testing showed a significant improvement in skin hydration and a reduction in skin water loss compared with baseline.
These findings support the product’s long-lasting hydration and moisture-retention positioning. The formula was also well tolerated in the documented study, with no adverse events reported. Individual experiences can vary according to skin condition, application amount, routine consistency and environmental conditions.
What the Product Does Not Do
Vaseline Light Hydrate is a daily cosmetic body moisturiser. It is not a medically proven treatment for eczema, psoriasis or other skin diseases, and it does not replace advice or treatment from a qualified healthcare professional.
Although the formula supports a brighter, more even-looking appearance, it does not permanently change natural skin colour. Use a dedicated sunscreen when sun protection is required.
